exceptions.reason: ESLint 9 is EOL, but the current React lint dependency chain still contains packages whose declared peer ranges do not cleanly include ESLint 10. Do not force-install or override peer dependencies in a public release.
exceptions.resolution: Automated dependency update PRs are disabled by maintainer decision; GitHub vulnerability alerts and pull-request dependency review remain enabled. Maintainers must update manifests and lockfiles together in focused reviewed changes. Re-evaluate the peer graph before expiry; the static source audit fails after the expiry date.
